edges.reason: Constructor rejects releaseTime <= block.timestamp, making deployment time-dependent.
release() is gated by require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime), a miner-influenceable condition.
Constructor writes the token parameter into _token.
Constructor writes the beneficiary parameter into _beneficiary.
Constructor writes the validated releaseTime into _releaseTime.
release() reads _releaseTime to authorize the transfer.
release() reads _token to query the contract balance.
release() reads _beneficiary as the transfer destination.
release() forwards tokens to the beneficiary through an external token call.
token() returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable.
releaseTime() returns the _releaseTime state variable.
RubicTokenLock constructor invokes the TokenTimelock constructor base.
Hardcoded IERC20 address supplied by the deployer constructor.
isContract derives its return value from the extcodesize assembly probe.
sendValue transfers control to an arbitrary recipient via a low-level ETH call.
Two-argument functionCall delegates to the custom-message variant.
functionCall delegates execution to _functionCallWithValue with zero value.
Three-argument functionCallWithValue delegates to the custom-message variant.
functionCallWithValue routes the call through _functionCallWithValue.
Four-argument functionCallWithValue routes the call through _functionCallWithValue.
_functionCallWithValue performs an unrestricted low-level call with attached value.
_functionCallWithValue requires isContract(target) before calling.
Revert data is bubbled through inline assembly on failure.
add computes the raw a + b sum before the overflow require check.
sub delegates to the custom-message variant.
sub computes the raw a - b difference before the underflow require check.

div delegates to the custom-message variant.
div performs unsigned division requiring a non-zero divisor.
mod delegates to the custom-message variant.
mod performs unsigned modulo requiring a non-zero divisor.
safeTransfer routes the encoded transfer through _callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom routes the encoded transferFrom through _callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove routes the encoded approve through _callOptionalReturn.
safeIncreaseAllowance routes the encoded approve through _callOptionalReturn.
safeDecreaseAllowance routes the encoded approve through _callOptionalReturn.

safeDecreaseAllowance reduces the allowance using SafeMath.sub.

_callOptionalReturn reaches the external call site through Address.functionCall.

normalization_plan.reason: account is a transient argument only meaningful for the extcodesize check in isContract.
size is a temporary result variable local to isContract.
recipient only parameterizes the low-level ETH transfer in sendValue.
amount only parameterizes the value and balance check in sendValue.
target is the callee address used exclusively by the low-level call helpers.
data is the raw calldata forwarded by the low-level call helpers.
errorMessage is only used as the revert reason of the custom-message helper.
value is the wei amount bound to the value-bearing call helper.
weiValue is the forwarded value inside _functionCallWithValue.
operand a is a pure arithmetic input to the SafeMath wrappers.
operand b is a pure arithmetic input to the SafeMath wrappers.
c is the transient checked arithmetic result.
token only selects the ERC20 instance targeted by safeTransfer.
to is the transfer destination encoded by safeTransfer.
returndata is a temporary buffer decoded inside _callOptionalReturn.
token constructor argument is persisted into _token by the constructor.
beneficiary constructor argument is persisted into _beneficiary by the constructor.
releaseTime constructor argument is validated and persisted by the constructor.
amount is the transient balance snapshot used by release() for the transfer.
